name: William F. Lyon, Wholesale Grocery Store

proprietors.name: Lyon, William F.
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card lyon_william_f (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The register resolved no place for this house at the scene date.
locations.limit_reason: Excluded from the scene-date town: chicago_democrat_1835_08_19#c015 announces this house opening on 1835-09-01, after the scene date — “will receive and offer for sale on the first of September”. Dated August 1835, so 'the first of September' is 1 September 1835 — two months after the scene date, and the stock is not in the store yet. No action; the record is kept so the exclusion can be argued with.
